notes: Added next set of stories for FEAT-1 focusing on core search logic, API exposure, and Mongo/vector integration completeness.

FEAT-1-STORY-065.title: Implement vector search with taxonomy fallback logic
FEAT-1-STORY-065.description: Build core provider search execution path that first performs MongoDB Atlas vector search and falls back to NUCC taxonomy-based search when vector results are insufficient or empty.

FEAT-1-STORY-066.title: Implement location filtering and FIPS-to-county resolution
FEAT-1-STORY-066.description: Add location filtering logic to provider search, including ZIP/state/city handling and FIPS-to-county mapping to ensure geographically relevant results.

FEAT-1-STORY-067.title: Expose provider search via FastAPI endpoint
FEAT-1-STORY-067.description: Create or validate FastAPI route that exposes provider search through the application, wiring request through tool_router and find_care_facade to return structured results.

FEAT-1-STORY-068.title: Integrate embedding client into provider search pipeline
FEAT-1-STORY-068.description: Ensure provider search uses embedding_client for query embedding generation and supports dual-model strategy for semantic retrieval.

FEAT-1-STORY-069.title: Validate MongoDB Atlas vector index integration
FEAT-1-STORY-069.description: Verify and configure MongoDB Atlas vector search index usage within provider_search_service, ensuring correct collection, index name, and query structure are used.
